title: SEVNT Studio Full Menu QA Coverage Plan

testLayers.name: Static implementation and selector inventory
testLayers.purpose: Verify every planned control maps to an existing UI element, renderer handler, preload API and main-process IPC handler where applicable.

testLayers.name: Renderer interaction tests
testLayers.purpose: Exercise visible controls, validation, navigation, empty/error states and state transitions in a real Electron window.

testLayers.name: Production IPC integration
testLayers.purpose: Launch the packaged/development Electron app with the real preload and main process; verify actual IPC handlers and side effects.

testLayers.name: Real media pipeline and output validation
testLayers.purpose: Run real FFmpeg/Python paths and inspect outputs with ffprobe plus decode/frame/audio checks.

testLayers.name: Persistence and restart regression
testLayers.purpose: Verify settings, history, assets and edits survive app restart where persistence is part of the feature.

menus.name: Clips
cases: Import local video; verify metadata and selected source.
Paste a supported video URL; validate accepted and rejected URL states.
Run Find Highlights; verify progress, completion, error and candidate list.
Exercise All/Hot/Saved filters and empty results.
Enter Select Mode; Select All, select individual, Clear, Done.
Preview each candidate; play/pause, seek, close and switch active candidate.
Render Selected and Render All; reconcile candidate count, render calls and outputs one-to-one.
Cancel in-flight pipeline/render and verify UI returns to a stable state.
Validate actual rendered files using ffprobe, non-zero duration/size and decode sample.

menus.name: Clip
cases: Verify all clip option groups and default values.
Change manual clip segment start/end and enforce valid duration/bounds.
Exercise aspect, quality, subtitle language/burn and speed options.
Navigate between clips and preserve the correct active clip.
Play, pause, seek and verify preview source/time.
Save clip options, navigate away/back and verify state.
Render a configured clip and verify output media metadata.
Reject invalid or contradictory trim/configuration values without corrupting state.

menus.name: Editor
cases: Open/close editor and load selected clip and transcript.
Edit caption text, timing and manual captions.
Change typography, case, size, color, position and style controls.
Change animation/effects and verify preview state.
Add, edit, reorder and delete title cards.
Exercise undo/redo across multiple edit operations.
Preview edits and verify preview reflects current edit state.
Render edited clip; verify subtitle/title content and media output.
Close/reopen editor and verify expected draft persistence or explicit reset behavior.

menus.name: Watermark
cases: Upload valid image watermark and reject unsupported/corrupt files.
Enable/disable watermark and verify visible state.
Exercise all anchor positions and X/Y geometry.
Change size and opacity; verify bounds and preview.
Delete stored asset and verify missing-asset handling.
Save settings, restart and verify persisted watermark configuration.
Render image and text watermark; inspect actual output frames.
Verify per-clip override precedence and reset-to-global behavior.

menus.name: Crop Studio
cases: Open Crop Studio with a selected clip and verify source media.
Exercise every aspect preset and free aspect.
Change X/Y position, zoom and crop bounds.
Add, select, navigate and delete keyframes.
Apply to current clip and Apply All; verify target scope.
Verify live preview and final crop geometry.
Render and validate dimensions, duration and decoded frames.
Verify disabled/gated state without a selected clip.

menus.name: Split Studio
cases: Open Split Studio and verify first source.
Enable/disable second source; select and replace source.
Exercise mute independently for source one and two.
Change split ratio and verify preview geometry.
Swap source positions and verify state.
Add/navigate/remove keyframes and exercise undo/redo if supported.
Apply split and verify actual rendered layout and audio mix.
Validate missing/invalid second source and recovery.
Verify remove-second-source returns to single-source state.

menus.name: History
cases: Load history list and handle empty history.
Refresh history and reconcile returned records.
Open a session and inspect clip metadata.
Delete selected clips with confirmation and verify filesystem/history update.
Delete a session with confirmation and verify safe path validation.
Restart app and verify history remains consistent.
Handle missing/corrupt report or media files without crashing.

menus.name: Settings
cases: Load settings and verify defaults and masked secrets.
Exercise add/test/delete lifecycle for every configured AI provider.
Change provider models and verify model selection persistence.
Change ASR engine and verify persisted selection after restart.
Save settings and verify read-after-write plus restart persistence.
Exercise cookies import/replace/clear and invalid-file handling.
Exercise Whisper/context model status, install/remove and progress/error states.
Exercise tracker and engine status/update/failure paths.
Exercise Telegram configuration, test/send and clear using a safe test double.
Exercise cache/disk usage/open/delete with bounded temporary test data.
Exercise license status/refresh/activation validation using dedicated test license only.
Exercise update check/download navigation without installing an uncontrolled update.

menus.name: Output
cases: Open output destination and verify correct folder/session.
Verify output action handles missing destination gracefully.
Verify rendered file exists, is readable and has expected codec/container.
Verify duration, dimensions, frame rate and audio stream with ffprobe.
Decode representative frames and audio; detect truncated/corrupt output.
Verify subtitles, titles, watermark and crop/split effects in output where enabled.
Verify filenames and output paths are safe and do not overwrite unrelated files.

menus.name: Help
cases: Open and close Help from all supported entry points.
Exercise every help section/tab and internal navigation.
Open external links safely and verify target URLs.
Exercise tutorial launch/replay/close and persisted completion state.
Verify unavailable links/media show a recoverable error.
Verify Help navigation does not break current workspace or selected project.

releaseGates: Every listed case has an explicit status; no case silently omitted.
All renderer interaction cases pass on supported macOS architectures.
All production IPC cases pass using src/preload.js and the real Electron main process.
All media cases pass with real FFmpeg/Python and ffprobe validation.
Persistence cases pass across a full app restart.
No TEMPORARY SKIP, placeholder assertion, or mock result is counted as production PASS.
Failure report identifies exact case, source file/line, layer, failure class, evidence and remediation.

implementation.scopeNote: All 88 case IDs are mapped into ten menu-level Playwright tests. The current suite runs against qa-electron-main.cjs and qa-preload.cjs; this is isolated renderer/fixture coverage, not production integration evidence. Some case groups include prerequisite/contract checks where the QA harness cannot reproduce the production side effect.
